description: Source code for IPC handler functions related to backup and restore services, including handling statistics, configuration restoration, backup triggers, and restore process management.

methods.name: handle_backupRestoreService_GET_RUNTIME_STATS_request
methods.description: Handles request to obtain current runtime statistics of the backup/restore service, including event, IPC, and process stats.

methods.name: handle_backupRestoreService_GET_SERVICE_STATUS_request
methods.description: Handles request to obtain current status of the backup/restore service.

methods.name: handle_backupRestoreService_CONFIG_RESTORED_request
methods.description: Handles notification that configuration data was restored, allowing the service to import files from restore directory.

methods.name: handle_CONFIG_UPDATED_request
methods.description: Handles notification that a configuration file has been altered, triggering a backup if not already running.

methods.name: handle_FORCE_BACKUP_request
methods.description: Forces an immediate backup if not already in progress.

methods.name: handle_START_RESTORE_PROCESS_request
methods.description: Starts the restore process, preventing other backups during restore, and reports progress steps.
